## What would you like to improve?

Describe the topic, correction, or practical example you think would help readers.

## Where does it belong?

Link the relevant page or describe a missing section.

## Evidence or context

For factual or platform-specific changes, include a link to an authoritative source when possible. Please do not include credentials, private customer data, or confidential information.
